name: Celebrities
overview: Scripture warns believers to remain steadfast in worshiping the LORD alone, rejecting any false gods or deceptive influences that may arise, as seen in Exodus 22:20 and Matthew 24:24. The fear of human reproach or the allure of popular approval should not deter those who know righteousness from holding fast to God's law, as Isaiah 51:7 exhorts. The passages emphasize the danger of being led astray by false signs and the importance of discerning true faith amid external pressures, encouraging believers to trust in God's truth rather than the consensus or admiration of men.
